HLAGenotyping.base_file_name.description: Base file name for the output files (to be used as the prefix)

HLAGenotyping.graphs_files_tar.description: HLA-LA graphs files tar (required if using HLA-LA)

HLAGenotyping.hla_genotyping_tool.description: HLA genotyping tool to use. Options: 'HLA-LA' or 'T1K'

HLAGenotyping.input_cram_bam.description: Input CRAM or BAM file for annalysing HLA genotyping

HLAGenotyping.input_cram_bam_index.description: Input CRAM or BAM index file for annalysing HLA genotyping

HLAGenotyping.reference_genome.description: Genome type selector (hg38 or hg38_nist_v3_with_decoy). Determines which reference files to use.

HLAGenotyping.t1k_index_tar.description: T1K index tar.gz containing hlaidx/ and kiridx/ directories with all index files (_seq.fa and _coord.fa). Required if using T1K.
